minimumExecutionContract: Freeze all sixteen original-file hashes and one random A/B mapping before the single attempt. Exactly the existing eight fixed city views and reference01-08; no ninth-frame substitution or favorable selection. Copy bytes to neutral names without cropping, recoloring, removal of visible characters or other changes to the judged element.

Use one fresh single-turn vision process. The prompt must bind each unique A01..A08/B01..B08 label immediately to one <__media__> marker, in exactly the same order as the sixteen --image arguments. Keep the private source mapping, this source-aware review, acquisition URLs/filenames, known-source notes and implementation source out of the evaluator input.

Use context32768, image-min-tokens1024, output cap1500 with concise text. Calculated image slots29784 leave2984 for prompt, image wrappers and output; after the chosen output cap,1484 remain. Preserve actual decode-token logs; context allocation or final M-RoPE position alone is not ingestion proof. Do not silently lower image resolution to make the budget fit.

Require source/role recognition first, sixteen distinct image IDs each with a concrete visible anchor and pertinent visual observation, four set-level axes (directional lighting/shadow hierarchy, palette, grounding/contact, texture scale coherence), and one whole-element A/B/tie preference. Missing/nonvisible details must be explicit. This is a concise single answer, not sixteen preference trials or a demand for exhaustive prose.

Audit raw output against the exact originals without rejudging or selecting the preferred answer: any recognized source/role anywhere, missing or misbound image, invented material claim, inadequate relevant coverage or unfinished answer invalidates it. A no-recognition self-report and exit0 do not prove validity. Preserve failed/invalid/reference-preferred results; do not rerun unchanged material for a favorable outcome.

Keep locked criterion coverage separate from the anonymous aesthetic question. All eight views are required for BM-VIS-01; each visible sky must satisfy the existing cool-color rule for BM-VIS-02. BM-VIS-03/04 zero-breakdown claims cannot cover unseen contacts/interiors or unresolved texture detail by inference from a global preference. BM-VIS-04 also retains the existing bench_measure evidence requirement. Do not supply project-specific implementation/source clues to the judge or weaken a criterion to make a preference count as full E-16 achievement.
largestRemainingRisk: The evaluator may identify the distinctive original source, overlook or bind some of sixteen images incorrectly, or offer credible-sounding but nonvisible contact/texture reasons. The existing basic control establishes only a limited vision input path, with an imprecise triangle location. More generic controls would not prove artistic judgment or blindness. A finite honest attempt followed by image-grounding/source-recognition audit is the useful next step; invalid output leaves E-16 unmeasured.
rawRequiredFromActualAttempt: Exact immutable prompt bytes/hash; neutral file hashes; private mapping committed before output; ordered argv, runtime/model hashes, cwd, relevant env, start/end and exit status.
Complete unedited stdout/stderr, including failed decode or truncated generation and all media batches/token counts.

Exact sixteen-ID coverage and visible-anchor audit, recognition admission anywhere in raw output, four-axis scope check, one unchanged overall preference; record invalid causes rather than manufacture a score.
